name: Problem Framing Canvas
deliverable: Bounded problem definition with user impact and business context

steps.text: State the boundary: this session defines the problem, not features or specifications.
Each person writes one observable user friction per note, in silence. No causes or fixes.
Map each friction to its business cost: lost revenue, churn, or support load.
Cluster the notes and merge duplicates until a few distinct problems remain.
Draft the statement three ways and choose the one the room can defend.

failure: Solution jumping: the statement names the fix the room already wanted, so the session debates a tool.
intervention: Strip the tool out of the sentence. Ask what happens in the workflow that costs measurable time or money; rewrite it without naming a product.
provenance: Source protocol: the steps follow the written script in the source.

origin.note: Widely used in design practice; no single documented originator.
